content: Mundu yuyaigunata mana llaquinachu
Imamandata cangunapurallata piñana yuyais macanacuna yuyais llucshinaun. Caimandami: canguna shungu ucui amu munaita yapa yuyarishami piñanacusha macanacunguichi.

Imagunatas munasha japinata mana ushashaga huanchisha ninguichi japingahua. Shuc runa charishcata yapa munasha imasnata japisha nisha piñarisha macanacunguichi. Imamandata canguna munashcata mana charinguichi. Diosta mana mañasha tapushcamandami.
Diosta mañasha tapushallata mana ali shunguhuan tapunguichi. Canguna aicha munashcamandallata yuyarisha tapushcata Dios mana cunzhu.

Canguna shuc ashiyac runashina ishcai (2) yuyaiyuc anguichi. Diospa runa mani nishallata mundu yuyaihuan purisha ninguichi. Chasna nisha shucpa huarmihuan purishcacuinta tucushcanguichi. Manachu yachanguichi, mundu yuyaihuan purinata munac runaga Diosta piñac runa man.
Yaya Dios ñucanchi shungu ucuibimi paihua Samaitaga churashca. Paihua Samaiga ñucanchita yapa munan Diosllahuan purinauchun nisha. Diospa shimi chasna nishcaga yangami nisha yuyaringuichichu.
Pai llaquishcamanda ñucanchita ashcata yanapan. Chimandami paihua shimi nin:

content.text: Maican ñuca yali balic mani nic runata Dios piñanmi,
randi Diospacpi mana balicchani nic mansu runata Dios yanapanmi nin.

content: Chasna yachasha camba munaita Diosma cuichi. Supaita mana uyasha paihuacpi mana manzhasha shayarichi, chasna racpi pai cangunamanda miticusha anchuringami.

Yaya Diospagma caillayaichi. Paihuagma caillayacpi pai cangunahuagma caillayangami. Juchayuccuna, canguna maquita maillashcacuinta jucha rashcagunata illacta saquichi. Dios munashcata ranatas juchata ranatas, ishcandita (2) ranataga mana ushanguichichu. Imatas mana alita yuyarinataga saquisha canguna shunguta alichichi.
Can juchata rashcamanda llaquirisha huacaichi. Jiridsa asishcagunata, yanga causashcatas saquisha llaquirisha huacaichi.
Yaya Dioshuan cuintasha mana balicchani nisha rimaichi. Chasna camba shungu ucui yuyaricpi Dios canda sirtu rimangami balic mangui nisha.
Jiridsata ama rimanacunachu

Jiridsata ama rimanacuichichu huauquiguna. Can shuc quiric huauquimanda jiridsata rimashaga, pai juchata rashcamandas mana alita rimashaga, Dios mandashca shimi llaquinacuichi nishcata mana pactanguichichu, chiga mana balicchan nisha. Mana pactachishaga chi mandashcata mana uyanachu nisha rimanguichi, yanga man ninguichi. Chi mana pactachic runaga shuc taripac amucuinta tucun Dios mandashcagunata mana uyangahua yali ali mani nisha.

Diosmi cushca chi mandashcagunata. Chi mandashcagunata alita mana alita pactachictaga yachasha pailla taripac man. Taripasha ucupachama cachanatas ushan, chasnallata pailla quishpichinatas ushan. Chasna acpi canga imaraicuta shucpa juchata yuyaringui caudsayachingahua.
Caya tucunata Dioslla yachan
Cunan yuyarichi. Cangunapura cuintanacusha ninguichimachari cunan punzha asha caya punzha asha llactama rinchimi, shuc huatata chibi tarabasha ashca cullquita ganangaraunchi nisha rimanguichima.
Caya ima tucunatas mana yachaibacchu. Can huañuna punzhata yachanguichu. Mana. Tutamanda ricuric puyu mana unaita tiyasha chingaringa. Ñáucanchi causai chasnallatami, mana unaita duran.
Chasna acpi casna rimanami, Yaya Dios munacpiga caitas chitas rangaraunchi nisha rimanami.
Canguna randi shuc tunuta yuyarishcanguichi. Ñáucanchi quiquin munaita rasha ali tucunchi nisha rimaunguichi. Chasna alabarisha rimanaga mana alichu.
Maican runa alita ranata yachashallata mana rashaga juchatami ran.
